source: GEM wiki Almaty-3 (Aug 2026); Kapital.kz 19.09.2026

source: azh.kz 14.01.2026; dknews.kz 17.09.2026; caspianlife.kz 09.10.2023

Name: Zhezkazgan CHP gas CCGT
source: GEM wiki Zhezkazgan (Oct 2026)
note: New gas combined-cycle CHP unit, construction launched March 2025, planned 2026. Existing coal units not scheduled for retirement.

Name: Aktobe Ferroalloy Plant waste-gas power plant (Kazchrome)
source: GEM wiki Aktobe Ferroalloy Plant power station (Oct 2026)
note: Waste-to-energy plant on ferroalloy (furnace off-) gas from Smelting Shop No. 4 of the Aktobe Ferroalloy Plant (TNK Kazchrome, ERG); gas currently flared (>600 mln m3/yr). EPC contract ERG - China TianChen Engineering (Apr 2025), KZT 45 bn; public hearings Jun 2025; construction started Nov 2025; completion planned 2026. Fuel: ferroalloy off-gas with natural gas (GEM). MODELLING: tagged Fueltype=OCGT (gas-fired steam convention), Technology=Steam Turbine. Same site as Akturbo (KZ-PP-0040).

Name: Kyzylorda CCGT (Aksa Energy)
source: GEM wiki Kyzylorda CHP (Oct 2026); vlast.kz 13.04.2026 (MoE); khabar.kz 21.08.2025; kapital.kz 23.12.2022; gov.kz 25.08.2022
note: Owner Aksa Energy Qyzylorda LLP (Aksa Enerji, Turkey). 240 MW el / 277 Gcal/h, KZT 215 bn, on the site of the existing Kyzylorda CHP. Target slipped from end-2025 to 2026; Apr 2026: both gas turbines in round-the-clock commissioning at ~170 MW, steam turbine to follow. Not in operation on 1 Jan 2026.

Name: Tekeli CCGT steam turbine
source: gov.kz 08.04.2026 (Tekeli site 24 -> 77 MW; 3 GTs 36 MW in 2025; third stage due Jul 2026)
note: Steam-turbine stage completing the Tekeli combined cycle; 17 MW derived = 77 (site total) - 24 (CHP-2) - 36 (gas turbines). Due July 2026.

source: kursiv.media 01.11.2024; national infrastructure plan Jul 2024 (via Kursiv)
note: 5 Hitachi gas turbines x 42 MW, simple cycle, natural gas only (no backup fuel). Company target Q1 2027 (national plan 2028); construction start was planned Q3 2025 - no later confirmation found. Waste-heat boilers/steam turbines only as a possible later stage. Cost 114.5 bn KZT.

Name: Aktau Energy Company CCGT
source: primeminister.kz 23.07.2026; inform.kz (reprint)
note: New plant by TOO Aktau Energy Company (not MAEK), Aktau. 160 MW combined cycle, USD 210M, ~30% built Jul 2026, commissioning expected June 2027. Exact site and coordinates not found - to add.

source: kus.com.kz; GEM wiki Karabatan (Electric Power Development Plan Feb 2024; National Infrastructure Plan Jul 2024; DBK Apr 2026)
note: 165 MW combined-cycle block; investment agreement Dec 2024; target Dec 2027 but still at financing/indicative-analysis stage (DBK Apr 2026). KUS also mentions a 330 MW second stage (2x165).

source: GEM wiki Kazakhmys Balkhash (Oct 2026): Kazakhmys Energy Nov 2024; public hearings Q1 2025; National Coal Generation Project Apr 2026

source: GEM wiki (Oct 2026, PM visit Jan 2026); Inbusiness 16.10.2024 (feasibility options 500/550/636, EPC 540)

source: GEM wiki (Oct 2026, citing EDB Sept 2025); Severin Development 12.02.2026
